cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a night-train sleeper compartment with a narrow berth — holds her keepsake at chest height; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — holds a red oil-paper umbrella open over her shoulder; a sunlit white marble temple — holds a small bouquet at chest height; a wooden river dock above calm water — standing; a mirrored dance — holds a water bottle at chest height; an ancestral shrine hall with a bronze incense burner — standing; overgrown jungle temple ruins — kneeling on the ground; a misty enchanted garden of moss — standing; a snowy mountain-lodge terrace with a wooden railing and benches above a winter valley — standing; a mossy path under ancient oaks with shafts of light — standing; a Three Kingdoms festival street — lying on her front; a floating sky garden of hanging vines and flowering terraces above the clouds — holds her keepsake at chest height; a city park with benches — brings an ice cream cone to her lips
